name: Five-Year Residency

requirements.blocker_text: At least 10 years of legal residence inside the Kingdom, without a continuous renewal gap exceeding 6 months.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years of legal residence in Jordan without a renewal lapse over 6 months.

requirements.blocker_text: Must hold investor, associate, or unclassified-profession residency status.

sources.title: Jordan Public Security Directorate (PSD), Borders and Residence Department -- Information Services: Five-Year Residency, free of charge, requires at least 10 years' cumulative legal residence in the Kingdom without a renewal gap exceeding 6 months, and investor/associate/unclassified-profession status

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jordan). STATUS: DRAFT -- name is a source artifact: PSD's own service listing calls this the 'Five-Year Residency' because of the permit's duration, not a 5-year qualifying period -- the actual qualifying threshold is 10 years of cumulative prior legal residence, modeled correctly here (months_legal_residence_cumulative >= 120) despite the route's official name. This is Jordan's closest equivalent to a long-term/permanent residence status in the dataset's schema sense; no separate unlimited/indefinite-duration residence category was found in this pass -- the 5-year permit itself is understood to be renewable indefinitely once granted, per PSD's renewal-service listing, though this was not explicitly stated as a distinct 'permanent' status.
